instruments.cmj: My Jump Lab, average of 3, at the end of the Day 1 warm-up (straight after the jump ramp), from 16 Nov 2026; readings up to 10 Nov 2026 were taken before the warm-up and are not compared with later ones
instruments.rsi: My Jump Lab drop jump, or the app's frame calculator; RSI = flight time / contact time; same method always

ladder.note: On Day 1 of these programme weeks the rsi_ladder item takes the place of the first replaced item in the template and every other replaced item is dropped. Fixed text only; no ladder logic in the app. Spec A.21.

text.warmup: Your glute warm-up. Finish with 3 to 5 small bounces on the spot and 2 jumps building from easy to near-max. On Day 1 the jump test comes straight after; then start the first explosive exercise within 1 to 3 minutes.
text.cmj: Straight after the 2 building jumps that end your warm-up. Leave the same gap between the three jumps every time.
text.light_week: Light week: {sets} sets of {reps} at this load. Stop at {reps}, even if you have more.
text.session_note: Running long? First drop the upper pair to 2 rounds, then swap the split squat for the hack squat. Never cut the explosive work or the abduction.
text.session_note_day1: Running long? First drop the upper pair to 2 rounds, then leave it out. Never cut the jumps, the front squat or the Romanian deadlift.
text.session_note_day2: Running long? First drop the upper pair to 2 rounds, then swap the split squat for the hack squat. Never cut the explosive work or the abduction.
text.short_day1: Only 45 to 50 minutes? Keep the jump test, drop jumps, trap-bar jumps, front squat and dumbbell Romanian deadlift. Everything else goes this time; skip it with Time as the reason.
text.short_day2: Only 45 to 50 minutes? Keep the jump shrug and landmine clean and push press at 2 sets each, the deadlift, and the split squat with the seated abduction. The carry and row go this time; skip them with Time as the reason.
text.doubles: Earlier doubles: stop with 2 to 3 left. The last double may go to 1 left, never to 0. Log the reps you really had left; the last double moves your max.
text.double_one: One double with 2 to 3 left. Log the reps you really had left.
text.single: Work up to one clean rep with 1 to 2 left, then log the weight and how many you had left. Today's doubles are worked out from it.
text.accessory_effort: Earlier sets with 1 to 2 left. Last set: as many clean reps as you can, up to the last one with good form.
text.note: Shown on screen as written. In light_week, {sets} and {reps} are that day's light-week prescription: 3 and 4 on every normal light week, so it reads exactly as approved; on a forced two-set light day it reads 2 sets. Display only; no rule reads any of these. Engine spec A.39. v1.8: session_note_day1 and session_note_day2 replace session_note on their day; short_day1 and short_day2 are the short-session list (rationale v3.5), shown on every session except the taper. Display only. v1.9: cmj_when labels the jump test on today's and the next session; the jump test moves to the end of the warm-up (rationale v3.6). v1.10: doubles, double_one and single are the heavy-doubles and test-single words (engine A.43, A.44); accessory_effort is the effort rule for class B and C slots, whose rir_cap is now 0 (display only; rationale v3.7).

tissue_check.prompt: Any tendon pain above 3/10 in the last 48 hours?
tissue_check.note: Record only (engine spec A.29, A.36). Asked at the start of every session, Day 1 and Day 2. No is one tap; site and score are asked only after Yes. It never blocks logging.

phase_tests.note: Record only (engine spec A.35). On the first Day 1 of each listed block the slot named here is placed just before before_slot, at the start of the explosive work. Its text is the slot's cue.

audit_trims.note: On a session whose main lift is entering one of boundary_singles_on_entering (the session that opens with a boundary test single, engine spec A.8 and A.15), the listed slots for that day and every item in the day's last block marked upper are prescribed at most max_sets sets. Nothing else changes. Engine spec A.34.

depth_jump.name: Depth jump
depth_jump.note: Fixed prescription. Athlete edits contacts by judgement; the design intent for late M2 is 8, see rationale.

rsi_ladder.name: RSI ladder 20/30/40 cm x3 + 3 at winner
rsi_ladder.when: descriptive only; the schedule is the top-level ladder field

skater_bound.name: Skater bound
skater_bound.cue: Stick each landing with a level pelvis and the knee over the foot. End the set if the hip drops or the knee caves in.

trap_bar_jump.name: Trap-bar jump
trap_bar_jump.progress: height at fixed load; +2.5 after rise then two flat sessions

jump_shrug.name: Jump shrug
jump_shrug.progress: load at visible speed: you set it at the first session; +2.5 kg after two sessions with no stop-rule cut
jump_shrug.cue: Take these from the deadlift bar during your warm-up, before loading it for the work sets. Load by speed, not by a percentage: work up in small jumps and stop at the heaviest load where every rep is still fast.

db_pp_explosive.name: DB push press, explosive
db_pp_explosive.progress: speed at a fixed dumbbell: you set it at the first session; no load step inside a mesocycle

landmine_cpp.name: 1-arm landmine clean and push press
landmine_cpp.progress: load at catch speed: you set it at the first session; +2.5 kg after two sessions with no stop-rule cut

db_rdl.name: Romanian deadlift, dumbbells, 3 s lowering
db_rdl.note: Load per hand. The rep target comes from the template item (8 in Block 1, 6 from Block 2): up at the target + 2 twice running, down below the target twice running (engine spec A.33).

abductor_hsr.name: Standing cable hip abduction, 3 s, stance leg loaded

seated_abduction.name: Seated hip abduction machine, heavy, 3 s lowering
seated_abduction.note: Same rule as abductor_hsr. The cable abductor's load does not carry over, because the implement differs.
swaps: Standing cable hip abduction, 3 s lowering

db_pp_strength.name: DB push press, strength thread (hammer grip)

spanish_squat_iso.name: Spanish-squat isometric primer
spanish_squat_iso.cue: 4 hard holds of about 10 seconds, first thing in the warm-up.

oh_carry.name: 1-arm overhead carry
oh_carry.cue: 2 carries per side, about 20 m each. Progress distance, then load. Use a front-rack carry if the shoulder flags.

phase_test.name: Phase-start test
phase_test.cue: Film 3 drop jumps and 1 trap-bar jump set in slow motion; they are the first 3 of your drop jumps and your first trap-bar set, not extra. Reactive strength index is time in the air divided by time on the floor: My Jump Lab's drop jump test gives it, or use Calculate from video. Enter your best of each.
phase_test.note: Record only. Never in a template: placed by the top-level phase_tests rule (engine spec A.35) and logged with kind phase_test, which changes nothing but the log.

items.note: You may take up to 9 jumps by judgement.

templates_before.note: A session dated before this date is planned from these templates (the Block 1 templates of programme_config_v1_5.json, unchanged) instead of the ones above: the plan rebuilt for a session that has no saved plan, a missed session added for such a date, and a session carried on from such a date. Every log, old or new, replays through the same slot rules. Engine spec A.37.

scope_note: v1.1: classes D, E, F are fixed prescriptions with no engine logic. Fields such as 'sites', 'group', 'progress' on slots are descriptive only. v1.2: ladder schedule added as data (top-level 'ladder'); nothing else changed. v1.6 (19 Oct 2026): new templates for every block, with no contrast rounds anywhere; slots db_rdl and seated_abduction added; nordic, abd_iso, y_raise, pallof, hack_squat, depth_landing, rdl, abductor_hsr and rsi_ladder leave every template but stay defined so older logs replay and export; per-slot swaps and on-screen cues; slot phase_test added; top-level text, tissue_check, phase_tests, audit_trims and templates_before added; template items may carry note and reps_by_week, blocks may carry upper. Slot fields sites, group, progress, note, cue and swaps stay descriptive for the engine. v1.7: rir_step (A.40), TAPER pre_days (A.41), jump shrug cue by speed, seated abduction swap; nothing else changed. v1.8: per-day running-long notes and the short-session list (display text only); nothing else changed. v1.9: Blocks 3 and 4 Day 1 keep the DB push press strength thread at 2 sets with the pull-up; jump test at the end of the warm-up; phase-test words; nothing else changed. v1.10: Blocks 2, 3, 4 and the taper run heavy doubles (engine spec v1.11 A.43): 3 doubles in Block 2, 2 in Blocks 3 and 4, 1 in the taper, at 87% of estimated max, with the training max moving from the last double until week 22; test singles take a reps-left choice (A.44); class B and C slots carry rir_cap 0 (the last set may go to technical failure). Nothing else changed.

rir_step.note: Engine spec A.40 (v1.10). On class B and C streak slots, a last set that reaches the rep target (and stays below up_at) with at least min_rir reps in reserve counts towards a step up, the same as a set at or above up_at. Applies only to logs dated on or after `from`, so every older log replays to the same numbers.
